weights_normalized.statement: Weights summing to something other than 100 (for example 30,30,20 = 80) are divided by their total so the normalized weights sum to 100%.

weighted_final.statement: The final grade is the sum of score times normalized weight; with weights 30,30,20 and scores 90,80,70 it is (90*30 + 80*30 + 70*20) / 80 = 81.25.

class_statistics.statement: For final grades 60, 70, 80, 90 the report shows mean 75.00, median 75.00, population standard deviation 11.18, highest 90.00 and lowest 60.00; an odd count uses the middle value for the median.
must_include: class mean, median, standard deviation, highest, lowest

invalid_input_exit_2.statement: A missing file, bad header, unknown or missing assessment, blank or non-numeric score, score outside 0-100, non-positive weight or zero weight total exits 2 with a message on stderr and no grades on stdout.

cli_output.statement: Running grade_calc.py <scores.csv> <weights.csv> exits 0 and prints one line per student (name, final grade, letter, GPA) followed by the class statistics.
